scope: Current source with the saved pool(4,64): 122 HTTP regression requests followed by actual concurrent-worker, queue-capacity, overload rejection, FD-recovery and 200-request concurrent-burst checks. Normal 30-second socket options unchanged. This is not the final full-stage acceptance; actual receive/send timeout waits and fault injection are not rerun.
temporary_source_change: Only a temporary tcp_server.cpp copy changes port 8080 and address log strings to an allocated loopback port; all other C++ sources, including main.cpp with pool(4,64), are compiled from the repository unchanged.

http_regression.scope: Current-source partial request-target integration review: 107 prior HTTP cases, with three documented adaptations for newly authorized earlier rejection, 12 partial-prefix/HEAD/4096/4097/query/absolute/method/default-version cases, two buffered-input TCP-close probes, and a recovery request. Loopback temporary port, saved production pool(4,64), 30-second socket options. Excludes actual timeout tests, concurrency and full-stage acceptance.
